players.product: Atlas and Origin agentic target-to-antibody discovery platform

quarterly_data.signal: CMO Ransi Somaratne on the ABS-201 HEADLINE trial: in the June interim Phase I data, blinded aggregate interim data suggest the study drug was well tolerated and exhibited a favorable safety and tolerability profile, and Absci continues to be encouraged by the emerging safety, pharmacokinetic and immunogenicity profile; the multiple ascending dose portion continues to enroll according to plan. HEADLINE is randomized, double-blind and placebo-controlled; the primary endpoints are safety and tolerability, secondary endpoints include PK, PD, immunogenicity, target area hair count, target area hair width and target area darkening/pigmentation, and patient-reported outcomes are collected. For the 13-week interim readout Absci plans to present target area terminal hair count, hair width, darkness and updated safety and tolerability data; he said durability will not be answered fully at 13 or 26 weeks and the post-trial safety follow-up will likely give the first indication of durability.
quarterly_data.figure: blinded aggregate interim data well tolerated; MAD enrolling according to plan

quarterly_data.signal: CMO: with the safety, tolerability and PK data from the SAD portion of HEADLINE, Absci anticipates initiating a Phase II study of ABS-201 in endometriosis in the fourth quarter of this year. CFO Zachariah Jonasson: the current balance sheet supports an expansion of the planned endometriosis clinical trial, and he sees potential peak sales of over $4 billion in endometriosis; Absci is also progressing a preclinical anti-prolactin receptor program, ABS-202, in an undisclosed immunology & inflammation indication and exploring other indications for prolactin receptor inhibition. CMO: as in hair loss, he thinks high receptor occupancy is needed for efficacy in endometriosis; other prolactin receptor antibodies showed some effect on symptoms like dysmenorrhea at their highest doses.
quarterly_data.figure: endometriosis Phase II initiation anticipated in the fourth quarter of 2026; endometriosis peak sales over $4 billion

quarterly_data.signal: CFO: consumer research and KOL input indicate that a 26-week increase in target area hair count of 30 to 35 hairs per centimeter squared, roughly on par with high-dose oral minoxidil, would enable a home-run product; a result above that would expand the market and a less robust result would still unlock a multibillion-dollar opportunity. CEO Sean McClain: Absci plans to take ABS-201 to market itself and evaluates follow-on programs for self-commercialization, including possible OTC products sold alongside it, and he views the Eli Lilly strategic investment and collaboration on ABS-201 as achieving the large pharma partnership. CEO: HMI-115 dosed at 240 milligrams every two weeks oscillates at roughly 60% to 70% receptor occupancy, which he believes contributed to its lack of robust efficacy, while two to three ABS-201 doses sustain occupancy well above 90%. The indication was renamed from androgenetic alopecia to pattern hair loss with no change to the indication or the population studied; recent female ex vivo data looked very similar to the male data and Absci is excited to enroll the female cohort in the study.
quarterly_data.figure: 26-week target 30 to 35 hairs per centimeter squared; HMI-115 roughly 60% to 70% receptor occupancy vs ABS-201 well above 90%
